reasoningText.text:
Let me analyze this case:

1. Gaby Grips is asking about November session dates because she wants to bring two guests.
2. The CLUB FACTS don't include any session dates — I must not invent dates. The fees are listed (jahresbeitrag 60.0, gardemitglied 30.0, hardness waiver max 60.0), but no session dates or guest card info.

Rules: "Never invent fees or members; look up before updating; add only with complete data." Also "if a fee is not listed, say you will confirm" — similarly, I shouldn't invent dates. So the reply should warmly acknowledge, say I'll confirm the exact dates (or ask the board), and mention guest policy briefly without inventing specifics.

Steps:
1. Look up Gaby in the register (gaby.grips@example.de).
2. Depending on lookup result, maybe update nothing (it's a pure question — no register change needed).
3. Draft a reply — warm, rheinisch-jovial, knapp, in German, max ~120 words, signed with the exact signature.
4. Log the activity.

Let me first look up the member. Since the reply doesn't depend on... well, actually the draft could reference her membership status, but it's a general question. Still, best practice: look up first, then draft. The lookup and draft are independent? The draft content might reference her record (e.g., if she's a member). I'll do the lookup first, then draft, then log. Actually, I can do lookup first, then draft + log together (log doesn't depend on draft result... well, log should state what was done — it's fine to do after draft).

Let me start with the lookup.

Draft reply in German, warm, jovial, concise:

"Jupp, dat is ja schön, Gaby!" — keep it friendly but professional.

Something like:

"Hallo Gaby,

danke für Deine Anfrage! Ich muss die genauen November-Termine noch kurz beim Elferrat abklären — damit ich Dir nix Falsches schicke. Ich melde mich schnellstmöglich, sobald die Termine feststehen.

Zwei Gäste sind herzlich willkommen! Sobald ich die Termine habe, sag ich Dir auch gern kurz Bescheid, wie wir die Gäste am besten anmelden.

Bis bald am Rhein!

Herzliche Grüße
[signature]"

Wait — signature must be exactly:
Der Elferrat
KG Rheinklause 1967 e.V.
(Entwurf erstellt von ClubSteward, dem Vereins-Agenten — vom Menschen freigegeben)

Keep under ~120 words. Good.

Register: nothing to update for a pure question — no updates needed. Only lookup to verify membership.

Log entry: "Terminanfrage von Gaby Grips (November-Sitzungen, 2 Gäste) — im Register geprüft, Antwort-Entwurf mit Hinweis auf Terminbestätigung und Gäste-Info gespeichert."

Let me execute: first lookup, then save_draft, then log_activity. Actually save_draft and log_activity are independent of each other, so I can call them together after the lookup.
